questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 6, 9, 15, 27, 51, ?
questions.solution: Differences double: 3,6,12,24,48. Next term =51+48=99.

questions.q: A can complete a piece of work in 24 days and B can complete it in 36 days. They work together for 6 days, after which A leaves. In how many more days will B complete the remaining work?
questions.solution: Six days complete 6(1/24+1/36)=5/12 of the work. Remaining 7/12 takes B 36×7/12=21 days.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 3, 4, 8, 13, 22, ?
questions.solution: Differences are 1,4,5,9; each new difference adds the previous two. Next difference is 14, so next term is 36.

questions.q: A train running at a speed of 90 km/hr crosses a pole in 12 seconds. It then crosses a bridge in 30 seconds. Find the length of the bridge.
questions.solution: Speed =90×5/18=25 m/s. The extra time beyond passing a pole is 18 seconds, representing the bridge length. Length =25×18=450 m.

questions.q: The length of a rectangle is 6 cm more than its breadth. The perimeter of the rectangle is 96 cm. A circle is drawn with radius equal to the breadth of the rectangle. Find the area of the circle. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.solution: Let breadth b; length b+6. Perimeter gives 4b+12=96, so b=21. Circle area =(22/7)×21²=1386 cm².

questions.q: A boat's speed in still water is 20 km/h. It takes 2 hours more to cover 75 km upstream than to cover the same distance downstream. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.solution: Let current speed be v. Then 75/(20−v)−75/(20+v)=2. The positive solution is 5 km/h.

questions.q: The average of five consecutive odd numbers is 51. Find the largest of these numbers.
questions.solution: The average of five consecutive odd numbers is their middle term 51. Largest is 51+4=55.

questions.q: The difference between the compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 12% per annum is Rs 216. Find the sum.
questions.solution: For two years, CI−SI=P(0.12)². Hence P=216/0.0144=₹15000.

questions.q: The ratio of the present ages of P and Q is 4:5. After 8 years, the ratio of their ages will become 5:6. Find Q's present age.
questions.solution: Set ages 4k and 5k. (4k+8)/(5k+8)=5/6 gives k=8; Q’s present age is 40.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks an article 50% above its cost price and then offers two successive discounts of 10% and 8%. Find his overall profit percentage.
questions.solution: Selling price as a fraction of cost is 1.5×0.9×0.92=1.242. Profit is 24.2%.

questions.q: In what ratio should rice worth Rs 40 per kg be mixed with rice worth Rs 55 per kg so that the resulting mixture is worth Rs 45 per kg?
questions.solution: Alligation gives cheaper:dearer=(55−45):(45−40)=10:5=2:1.
